Biography

I’m a 21-year-old second-year Computer Science student with a passion for graphic design. I thrive at the intersection of technology and creativity, bringing both problem-solving skills and visual innovation to every project.

I’m currently a second-year BS Computer Science student at AISAT College, building on my foundations in programming, algorithms, and problem-solving while applying them to graphic design work. Earlier, I trained in computer systems servicing and technical drafting, and gained real event experience in photography.
